scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 better preserves source-like instance size, total count and nearest-neighbor spacing with only a small clustering tradeoff.
Hard gates pass and sampling score is highest, but candidate 03 substantially better preserves source instance size while also preserving count and spacing.
All hard gates pass and mask review shows coherent moderate tumor-boundary expansion. Candidate 03 gives the best combined preservation of source instance size, count and nearest-neighbor spacing.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 46,526-pixel expansion follows the authorized elongated tumor-stroma interface and preserves surrounding immune and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Sixty-one class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.978, 1.119, 0.977 and 1.039.
decisions.coupling: Added tumor nuclei occupy the authorized expanded footprint; boundary, seam, quota, compatibility, distribution and density gates pass with sampling score 0.886.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and structures outside joint support remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Total instance count is 11.9% above source but inside frozen limits. This mask-only evidence is not generated-H&E, histologic truth or clinical validation.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
